check: Retains a memo/documentation describing the actual-wage system and how the H-1B wage relates to others.
threshold: Existence + adequacy of the actual-wage memo.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(b); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c).
information_needed: Boolean: actual-wage memo present; date; whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll.

check: If H-1B-dependent and/or a willful violator AND the LCA(s) indicate only "exempt" workers, PAF contains a list of those exempt workers.
threshold: A list naming each exempt worker. $60,000 is the statutory threshold, NOT inflation-adjusted (655.737(b)/(c)).
citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(9); exempt-worker list/definition 20 CFR 655.737(e)(1) & 655.737(b)-(c); INA 212(n)(3); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
information_needed: h1bDependentOrWillfulViolator (bool); lcaIndicatesExemptOnly (bool); exemptWorkerListPresent (bool); exemptWorkers (array of {workerId, basis, wageAmount, degreeLevel, degreeField}).

check: The wage level (I-IV) on the PWD matches the position's MINIMUM requirements per the OFLC 5-factor worksheet.
threshold: I=17th, II=34th, III=50th, IV=67th percentile; worksheet adds at most ~one level per factor; start at I.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A); DOL OFLC Prevailing Wage Determination Policy Guidance (rev. Nov 2009).
information_needed: Position SOC + O*NET Job Zone/SVP; minimum required experience years; minimum education; required special skills/licenses; supervises?; PWD's stated level + percentile; OES wage per level for that SOC/area.

check: The beneficiary actually holds the qualification the position requires (degree/field/license/equivalency), matching Q7/Q8.
threshold: Beneficiary credential ≥ required degree level AND field within Q8 acceptable fields (or a documented (C)(2)/(C)(3)/(C)(4) equivalency). Experience equivalency: 3 yrs specialized experience per 1 year of missing college; for a Master's-equivalent, bachelor's + ≥5 yrs.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(C)(1)-(4) and (D) (equivalency, incl. the 3:1 ratio); INA 214(i)(2).
information_needed: beneficiary.degreeLevel; degreeField; institutionAccredited (bool); licenses[]; yearsRelevantExperience; hSupp.q7_educationLevelRequired; q8_fieldsOfStudy; evidence.credentialEvaluation.

check: Retains a memo/documentation describing the actual-wage system and how the H-1B wage relates to others.
threshold: Existence + adequacy of the actual-wage memo.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(b); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c).
information_needed: Boolean: actual-wage memo present; date; whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll.

check: Employer physically (or via authorized remote alternative) examined original documents that reasonably appear genuine and relate to the person.
threshold: One List A doc, OR one List B (identity) + one List C (employment auth). Reasonable-appearance standard.
citation: 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii)(A); 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(v); remote alt 88 FR 47990 (publ. **July 25, 2023**; eff. Aug 1, 2023) / M-274 §4.5. Optional precision: cite **274a.2(b)(1)(ix)** (remote-alternative authority) and **274a.2(a)(2) / INA 274B (8 USC 1324b)** (employee-choice / anti-over-documentation).
information_needed: listA docs OR (listB + listC); per doc: title, issuing authority, number, expiration; remoteAlternativeUsed (bool); copiesRetained (bool, required if remote).

check: Employee checked exactly one of the four citizenship/immigration-status attestation boxes in Section 1.
threshold: Exactly one of four boxes; zero or multiple = defect.
citation: The four-box "check exactly one" rule lives on the **Form I-9 (ed. 01/20/25)** + **USCIS Form I-9 Instructions (01/20/25)** + **M-274 §3.0** — NOT in the reg. Regulatory duty to complete Section 1 + sign: **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(i)(A)**. Substantive/non-curable classification: **ICE Form I-9 Inspection fact sheet updated 2026-03-16**. Penalty **8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2)**.
information_needed: section1StatusAttested enum (citizen|national|lpr|alien_authorized|none); boxesCheckedCount; for LPR: aNumber; for alien_authorized: workAuthExpiry + one of (aNumber|i94|foreignPassport).

check: The employer's I-983 attestations are present and truthful: sufficient resources/personnel to train; will not replace a U.S. worker; the opportunity assists training goals.
threshold: All three attestations (i)-(iii) made and signed; each must be true.
information_needed: I-983 attestation checkboxes/signature; employer headcount + training personnel at the worksite; recent layoff/RIF/furlough records; training-resources description; worksite location(s).

check: E-Verify case created no later than the 3rd business day after the employee's first day of employment for pay.
threshold: 3 business days after the first day of work for pay (same counting basis as Section 2).
citation: E-Verify MOU (Article II); E-Verify User Manual (M-775) §1.4 / "Create a Case"; statutory basis IIRIRA §403 (Pub. L. 104-208).
information_needed: employeeId, firstDayOfWork, everifyCaseCreatedDate, everifyEnrolledFlag, businessDayCalendar, federalContractorFlag, delayReasonCode.

check: Notice to the bargaining rep, OR posted in 2 conspicuous locations for 10 days / delivered electronically, on or within 30 days before filing, with required content and dated proof.
threshold: 2 physical posting locations per worksite; 10 days posted/available; window = on or within 30 days BEFORE filing.
citation: **20 CFR 655.734(a)(1)(i)** (bargaining-rep notice + content + WHD statement, 30-days-before); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)** chapeau (no-rep notice content + "available for public inspection" + WHD statement); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)(A)** and **(a)(1)(ii)(A)(3)** (≥2 conspicuous locations, posted on/within 30 days before, 10 days); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)(B)** (electronic notice, 10 days, single direct e-mail suffices); **655.734(b)** (documentation); **655.734(c)/§655.760** (retention). **DROP the cite to "655.734(a)(1)(iii)" for content** — no such paragraph exists (content is carried in (a)(1)(i) and the (a)(1)(ii) chapeau).
information_needed: Per LCA: bargaining-rep exists? + notice date; OR posting locations (count + addresses) + start date + take-down date (≥10 days); OR electronic-notice method + window; content fields present; filing date.

check: Individual (non-new-office) L-1 petition validity ≤3 years and matches the period of established need.
threshold: ≤3 years per increment (established); ≤1 year for new office. Extensions ((l)(15)(ii)) ≤2-year increments, within the 5/7-year ceilings.
information_needed: petition_type (individual|blanket); new_office_flag; established_need_period; approved_validity_start; approved_validity_end; extension_increment.

check: The prevailing wage was obtained from one of the four permitted sources.
threshold: Source ∈ the four enumerated types; CBA controls where applicable; DBA/SCA controls on covered contracts.
information_needed: PW source type enum (NPWC_PWD | CBA | independent_survey | DBA | SCA); source document/ID; PW value; SOC + area.

check: H-1B petition filed on/after 2026-04-01 uses Form I-129 edition 02/27/26 (not 01/17/25).
threshold: Edition date (lower-right corner) must read 02/27/26 for filings on/after 2026-04-01; cutover = 2026-04-01.
citation: USCIS Form I-129 edition 02/27/26; form-edition acceptance policy on the I-129 forms page; PRA docket USCIS-2025-0040.
information_needed: petition.formEditionDate; petition.filingDate (or intended postmark); petition.classification (H-1B/H-1B1).

check: Classify each defect as substantive vs technical/procedural and apply the ≥10-business-day cure period correctly.
threshold: Substantive = no cure. Technical/procedural = ≥10 business days to cure; uncorrected → substantive. Cure period runs from ICE's notice.
citation: Cure provision = **INA 274A(b)(6) = 8 USC 1324a(b)(6)** ("not less than 10 business days") — **NOT 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(3)** (the cure period is statutory and does not appear in 274a.2). Penalty **8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2)** (correct). **The 1997 Virtue Memorandum no longer controls the classification** — superseded by the **ICE Form I-9 Inspection fact sheet updated 2026-03-16**. Current substantive examples include missing Section 1 date/signature/status, missing Section 2 document title/issuing authority/number/expiration, missing alternative-procedure checkbox where applicable, and missing Section 2 signature/date.
information_needed: per defect: defect type; section; prepared/presented flags; timeliness facts; cure status + cure date vs ICE notice date; retained-copy evidence may be captured for record completeness but must not lower severity.

check: Retains a memo/documentation describing the actual-wage system and how the H-1B wage relates to others.
threshold: Existence + adequacy of the actual-wage memo.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(b); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c).
information_needed: Boolean: actual-wage memo present; date; whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll.

check: Recapture / commuter / intermittent exceptions to the 5- and 7-year caps are correctly applied.
threshold: U.S. employment seasonal OR intermittent OR ≤6 months aggregate/year, no continual U.S. residence; OR resident-abroad regular commuter in part-time employment. Standard = clear and convincing.
information_needed: exception_claimed_flag; us_employment_pattern (seasonal|intermittent|aggregate_days_per_year|commuter); us_residence_continual_flag; days_in_us_per_year; tax_returns; arrival_departure_records; foreign_residence_evidence.

check: On any wage/benefit shortfall, back wages (and fringe) = difference between required and paid for the full violation period.
threshold: Back wages = Σ over the violation period of (required − actual) per worker; back fringe = (required benefit value − provided).
information_needed: Per worker per period: required wage; actual paid; hours; deduction amounts; benefit values; violation start/end.

check: Actual wage paid ≥ greater of (actual wage for similarly-employed workers) and (prevailing wage on the LCA).
threshold: max(actual_wage, prevailing_wage). A posted wage RANGE satisfies only if the bottom of the range ≥ prevailing wage. Hourly↔annual via 2,080 hrs/yr.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a); 655.731(a)(1) (actual); 655.731(a)(2) (prevailing); 655.731(c)(1) (cash in hand / free and clear).
information_needed: Per worker: LCA prevailing_wage (amount+unit+level); employer actual_wage for the role; gross wages paid per period; pay frequency; FT/PT; hours; cohort wage rates.

check: Certified LCA accompanies the H-1B petition and was filed no earlier than 6 months before the employment start date.
threshold: LCA filing date ≥ (employmentStartDate − 6 months); certified LCA exists before/with the I-129.
citation: 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months); 20 CFR 655.730(c)(3) (certified LCA submitted to USCIS with I-129).
information_needed: petitionId, lcaId, lcaFilingDate, lcaCertifiedDate, lcaCertificationStatus, employmentStartDate, i129FilingDate.

check: The LCA was filed while its supporting NPWC PWD was within the PWD validity window.
threshold: 90 ≤ PWD validity ≤ 365 days; filing date ∈ [determination date, expiration date].
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A); DOL OFLC NPWC guidance (validity period).
information_needed: PWD determination/issue date; PWD expiration date; LCA filing date.

check: Days spent physically outside the U.S. (>24h) during H-1B validity can be recaptured and added back to the 6-year max — petitioner must request and document them.
threshold: Recapturable = full days (>24h absences) physically outside the U.S. during validity periods. No temporal limit on claiming. Recapture of a cap-counted beneficiary does NOT re-subject them to the cap.
information_needed: I-94 arrival/departure travel history (every entry/exit), per-trip duration, petition validity windows, evidence-inventory flags (passport stamps/tickets).

check: Retains a memo/documentation describing the actual-wage system and how the H-1B wage relates to others.
threshold: Existence + adequacy of the actual-wage memo.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(b); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c).
information_needed: Boolean: actual-wage memo present; date; whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll.

check: All OPT employment is directly related to the student's major area of study (post-completion) / qualifying STEM degree (STEM extension).
threshold: Qualitative "directly related" — no numeric threshold. STEM training must relate to the specific qualifying STEM degree, not any prior degree.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10) (intro, "directly related to their major area of study"); 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(C)(4) (STEM "directly related to the degree").
information_needed: Student major/CIP, qualifying degree (STEM), job title, duties/description, employer SOC/industry. For STEM: the I-983 Section-5 "how training relates to the STEM degree" narrative.

check: I-94 admit-until date governs authorized stay; flag the gap where I-94 expires before/after petition validity, and the 10-day pre/post admission grace.
threshold: Authorized stay = min(I-94 admit-until, petition validityEnd + 10 days). Work window = petition validityStart..validityEnd only. Unlawful presence begins the day AFTER I-94 expiry absent a timely-filed extension.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(h)(13)(i)(A) (validity + 10-day pre/post); 8 CFR 214.1(l)(1) (10-day grace); admit-until controlling per 8 CFR 214.1(a)(3); unlawful-presence bars INA 212(a)(9)(B) / 8 USC 1182(a)(9)(B).
information_needed: i94.admitUntilDate, i94.mostRecentEntryDate, petition.validityStart/End, visaStamp.expiry (informational), any pending extension receipt + filing date.

check: Stated special skills (I-129 Q10) consistent with the LCA wage level.
threshold: Special skill/knowledge beyond normal entry = +1 step (DOL Step 4). Flag: non-empty special-skills requirement paired with Level I.
citation: DOL ETA PW Guidance (Nov-2009), Appendix A Step 4 (Special Skills, Knowledge, Licensure); 20 CFR 655.731.
information_needed: hSupp.q10_specialSkills; lca.wageLevel; lca.socCode; soc.entryLevelSkillBaseline.

check: 60-day grace period after cessation of qualifying employment for E/H-1B/H-1B1/L-1/O-1/TN — track when status/lawful presence ends (no work authorization during grace unless separately authorized).
threshold: Up to 60 consecutive days from cessation, or end of I-94, whichever SHORTER. Once per validity period.
citation: 8 CFR 214.1(l)(2) (60-day grace); 8 CFR 214.1(l)(1) (up to 10 days before/after petition validity).
information_needed: employeeId, classification, employmentEndDate, i94ExpiryDate, graceUsedThisValidityPeriodFlag, newPetitionFiledDate, portabilityEligibleFlag.

check: Photo-matching step performed and, on a photo-mismatch contest, a copy of the employee's document submitted to DHS.
threshold: Photo comparison recorded; on photo-mismatch contest, document copy uploaded to DHS.
citation: E-Verify User Manual §2.2.2 (E-Verify Photo Matching) and §3.3 (TNC handling); E-Verify MOU Art. II.
information_needed: section2DocType; photoMatchResult (match|no-match|recorded); on photo-TNC contest: documentCopySubmittedToDHS (bool); copyRetained (bool).

check: Response to a USCIS RFE filed by the deadline on the notice (max 12 weeks / 84 days), +3 days if served by mail.
threshold: By the date on the RFE; regulatory max 12 weeks (84 days) from issuance. +3 days if served by mail (8 CFR 103.8(b)).
citation: 8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)(iv) (12-week max); 8 CFR 103.2(b)(13)(i) (consequences); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
information_needed: caseId, rfeIssuanceDate, rfeResponseDueDate (as printed), serviceMethod (mail/electronic), responseFiledDate, responseReceivedConfirmation.

check: Reverification (Supplement B) completed on/before the date the employee's temporary work authorization expires.
threshold: Reverification recorded on/before the work-authorization expiration date.
citation: **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(vii)**; paperwork penalty **8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2)**; knowing-continued-employment penalty **8 CFR 274a.10(b)(1)** (use **(b)(1)(i)** for first-offense tier — (b)(1)(ii) is the *second*-offense tier, $5,724–$14,308).
information_needed: workAuthExpiry; reverificationDate (Supplement B); reverifiedDocType; current employment status.

check: H-1B petition (I-797) initial validity ≤3 years and ≤ the LCA validity period.
threshold: ≤3 years (specialty); validity end ≤ LCA end. 5 years for DOD R&D/coproduction.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(h)(9)(iii)(A)(1); validity tied to LCA per 20 CFR 655.730.
information_needed: petition.receiptNumber, validityStart, validityEnd, classification (specialty/DOD/fashion), lca.validityStart, lca.validityEnd.

check: Employee contacts DHS or visits SSA within 8 federal-government working days of referral (employer-side tracking of the resolution clock).
threshold: 8 federal-government working days from the referral date for the employee to contact DHS/SSA.
citation: E-Verify MOU (Article II); E-Verify User Manual (M-775) §3.3.3 (Referral Date Confirmation).
information_needed: everifyCaseId, referralDate, referralDateConfirmationProvidedFlag, employeeContactByDate, caseFinalResultDate/Result, adverseActionTakenFlag.

check: Student on post-completion OPT (without STEM extension) has not accrued >90 days of unemployment.
threshold: 90 days aggregate unemployment (hard cap).
information_needed: OPT EAD start, end, employment start/end dates + hours/week per employer, qualifying unpaid/volunteer periods, approved travel.

check: A material change in employment terms (or eligibility) requires an AMENDED or new I-129 (with a new LCA) before the change takes effect.
threshold: Material change → amended petition required. Immaterial (same-MSA move, successor-in-interest assuming the LCA, a promotion not affecting eligibility) → no amendment. File BEFORE the change takes effect.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(h)(2)(i)(E) (amended/new petition + new LCA); 8 CFR 214.2(h)(11)(i)(A) (immediate notification).
information_needed: current job: SOC, title, duties, worksite(s), wage, hours, employer entity; approvedPetition baseline of the same; changeEffectiveDate; corporateEvent (merger/acquisition + successor-in-interest flag); amendedPetition.filedDate.

check: Photo-matching step performed and, on a photo-mismatch contest, a copy of the employee's document submitted to DHS.
threshold: Photo comparison recorded; on photo-mismatch contest, document copy uploaded to DHS.
citation: E-Verify User Manual §2.2.2 (E-Verify Photo Matching) and §3.3 (TNC handling); E-Verify MOU Art. II.
information_needed: section2DocType; photoMatchResult (match|no-match|recorded); on photo-TNC contest: documentCopySubmittedToDHS (bool); copyRetained (bool).

check: Classify each defect as substantive vs technical/procedural and apply the ≥10-business-day cure period correctly.
threshold: Substantive = no cure. Technical/procedural = ≥10 business days to cure; uncorrected → substantive. Cure period runs from ICE's notice.
citation: Cure provision = **INA 274A(b)(6) = 8 USC 1324a(b)(6)** ("not less than 10 business days") — **NOT 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(3)** (the cure period is statutory and does not appear in 274a.2). Penalty **8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2)** (correct). **The 1997 Virtue Memorandum no longer controls the classification** — superseded by the **ICE Form I-9 Inspection fact sheet updated 2026-03-16**. Current substantive examples include missing Section 1 date/signature/status, missing Section 2 document title/issuing authority/number/expiration, missing alternative-procedure checkbox where applicable, and missing Section 2 signature/date.
information_needed: per defect: defect type; section; prepared/presented flags; timeliness facts; cure status + cure date vs ICE notice date; retained-copy evidence may be captured for record completeness but must not lower severity.

check: H-1B workers afforded working conditions (hours, shifts, vacation, seniority-based preferences) on the same basis as similarly-employed U.S. workers.
threshold: Same basis/criteria as similarly-employed U.S. workers (no quantitative threshold).
citation: 20 CFR 655.732(a) (attestation/scope); 655.732(b) (documentation).
information_needed: Scheduling/shift/vacation policy; seniority/training-program access rules; H-1B vs U.S.-worker comparison same occupation; complaints alleging adverse effect.

check: Stated minimum education (I-129 Q7) consistent with the LCA prevailing-wage LEVEL and the SOC/OEWS occupation.
threshold: Education above the O*NET-SOC E&T/Appendix-D usual category = +1 step per category above (DOL Step 3). Flag when education-implied level > LCA wage level.
citation: DOL ETA Prevailing Wage Determination Policy Guidance (Nov-2009), Appendix A Step 3 (Education); 20 CFR 655.731; cross-ref 8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A).
information_needed: hSupp.q7_educationLevelRequired; lca.wageLevel (I–IV); lca.socCode; soc.usualEducationCategory; lca.prevailingWageSource.

check: Response to a USCIS RFE filed by the deadline on the notice (max 12 weeks / 84 days), +3 days if served by mail.
threshold: By the date on the RFE; regulatory max 12 weeks (84 days) from issuance. +3 days if served by mail (8 CFR 103.8(b)).
citation: 8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)(iv) (12-week max); 8 CFR 103.2(b)(13)(i) (consequences); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
information_needed: caseId, rfeIssuanceDate, rfeResponseDueDate (as printed), serviceMethod (mail/electronic), responseFiledDate, responseReceivedConfirmation.

check: I-9s stored in a compliant medium and producible within 3 business days of an inspection request.
threshold: Production within 3 business days; electronic systems meet the security/audit-trail standard.
citation: **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)(i)-(ii)** (retention period + 3-business-days inspection notice / production-at-location) — *not* (b)(3), which is "Copying of documentation"; **8 CFR 274a.2(e)-(g)** (electronic retention standards: (e) controls/indexing, (f) documentation/audit trails, (g) security incl. (g)(1)(iv) secure-permanent-record-on-create/complete/update/modify/alter/correct); **M-274 §10.0–10.1** ("present within 3 business days of the date requested").
information_needed: storageMedium (paper|microfilm|electronic); for electronic: accessControls, backup, auditTrail, tamperEvident (bools); inspectionProducibility / time-to-produce.

check: Actual wage paid ≥ greater of (actual wage for similarly-employed workers) and (prevailing wage on the LCA).
threshold: max(actual_wage, prevailing_wage). A posted wage RANGE satisfies only if the bottom of the range ≥ prevailing wage. Hourly↔annual via 2,080 hrs/yr.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a); 655.731(a)(1) (actual); 655.731(a)(2) (prevailing); 655.731(c)(1) (cash in hand / free and clear).
information_needed: Per worker: LCA prevailing_wage (amount+unit+level); employer actual_wage for the role; gross wages paid per period; pay frequency; FT/PT; hours; cohort wage rates.

check: Prevailing wage from an acceptable source, correct skill level, within its validity window at filing.
threshold: PWD validity ≥90 and ≤365 days. Survey recency: data collected within 24 months preceding publication; latest published edition (published within 24 months before filing). Academic/research employers: level reflects only such institutions.
citation: **20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)** (PW determined "as of the time of filing"; greater-of); **655.731(a)(2)(i)** (CBA); **655.731(a)(2)(ii) / (a)(2)(ii)(A)** (OFLC NPC/OES, arithmetic mean of BLS OES); **655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A)** (validity "not less than 90 days or more than 1 year") and **(a)(2)(ii)(A)(1)** (file LCA within the PWD validity period); **655.731(a)(2)(ii)(B)/(C)** (independent authoritative / other legitimate source); **655.731(a)(2)(vii)** (academic/nonprofit-research carve-out); **655.731(b)(3) / (b)(3)(iii)(B)-(C)** (documentation incl. 24-month recency). **For the wage LEVEL I–IV tiering, cite 20 CFR 656.40(b)(2) + DOL OFLC PW guidance, NOT 655.731** ("level I-IV" does not appear in 655.731).
information_needed: PW source type; PWD tracking number + issue + expiration (if OFLC); OES area + SOC + level; survey publication date + data-collection window; CBA citation; employer entity-type flag (academic/research).

check: H-1B workers afforded working conditions (hours, shifts, vacation, seniority-based preferences) on the same basis as similarly-employed U.S. workers.
threshold: Same basis/criteria as similarly-employed U.S. workers (no quantitative threshold).
citation: 20 CFR 655.732(a) (attestation/scope); 655.732(b) (documentation).
information_needed: Scheduling/shift/vacation policy; seniority/training-program access rules; H-1B vs U.S.-worker comparison same occupation; complaints alleging adverse effect.

check: LCA used only within its certified validity period; H-1B petition not relying on an expired/withdrawn LCA.
threshold: Max validity 3 years (H-1B). Earliest filing: 6 months before start.
citation: 20 CFR 655.750(a) (validity, 3-yr max); 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months before start).
information_needed: Per LCA: certified start, certified end, filing date, intended start; mapped H-1B petition validity dates.

check: Notice to the bargaining rep, OR posted in 2 conspicuous locations for 10 days / delivered electronically, on or within 30 days before filing, with required content and dated proof.
threshold: 2 physical posting locations per worksite; 10 days posted/available; window = on or within 30 days BEFORE filing.
citation: **20 CFR 655.734(a)(1)(i)** (bargaining-rep notice + content + WHD statement, 30-days-before); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)** chapeau (no-rep notice content + "available for public inspection" + WHD statement); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)(A)** and **(a)(1)(ii)(A)(3)** (≥2 conspicuous locations, posted on/within 30 days before, 10 days); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)(B)** (electronic notice, 10 days, single direct e-mail suffices); **655.734(b)** (documentation); **655.734(c)/§655.760** (retention). **DROP the cite to "655.734(a)(1)(iii)" for content** — no such paragraph exists (content is carried in (a)(1)(i) and the (a)(1)(ii) chapeau).
information_needed: Per LCA: bargaining-rep exists? + notice date; OR posting locations (count + addresses) + start date + take-down date (≥10 days); OR electronic-notice method + window; content fields present; filing date.

check: Remote (alternative-procedure) exam used only by qualified E-Verify employers, with the box checked and copies retained.
threshold: E-Verify enrolled + good standing + case created (non-reverification) + live video + box checked + copies retained.
citation: **DHS final rule "Optional Alternatives to the Physical Document Examination," 88 FR 47990 (publ. July 25, 2023; eff. Aug 1, 2023)** — added **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ix)**; companion authorization notice **"Optional Alternative 1," 88 FR 47749 (July 25, 2023)** (sets out the five operative conditions); **M-274 §4.5**; 3-day clock **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii)**.
information_needed: remoteAlternativeUsed (bool); employerEnrolledInEVerify + goodStanding; eVerifyCaseCreated (except reverification); altProcedureBoxChecked; copiesRetainedFrontBack; liveVideoConducted (attested).

check: Employee contacts DHS or visits SSA within 8 federal-government working days of referral (employer-side tracking of the resolution clock).
threshold: 8 federal-government working days from the referral date for the employee to contact DHS/SSA.
citation: E-Verify MOU (Article II); E-Verify User Manual (M-775) §3.3.3 (Referral Date Confirmation).
information_needed: everifyCaseId, referralDate, referralDateConfirmationProvidedFlag, employeeContactByDate, caseFinalResultDate/Result, adverseActionTakenFlag.

check: If H-1B-dependent and/or a willful violator AND the LCA(s) indicate only "exempt" workers, PAF contains a list of those exempt workers.
threshold: A list naming each exempt worker. $60,000 is the statutory threshold, NOT inflation-adjusted (655.737(b)/(c)).
citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(9); exempt-worker list/definition 20 CFR 655.737(e)(1) & 655.737(b)-(c); INA 212(n)(3); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
information_needed: h1bDependentOrWillfulViolator (bool); lcaIndicatesExemptOnly (bool); exemptWorkerListPresent (bool); exemptWorkers (array of {workerId, basis, wageAmount, degreeLevel, degreeField}).

check: Extension/amendment of stay (I-129) filed up to 6 months before the start/current expiry, and MUST be filed before the current authorized stay expires to preserve status.
threshold: Earliest filing: 6 months (~180 days) before requested start. Latest to preserve status & 240-day coverage: ON or BEFORE the I-94 admit-until / petition validity end.
information_needed: petition.validityEnd, i94.admitUntilDate, extension.requestedStartDate, extension.filedDate, beneficiary.presentInUS (bool), employment.continuing (bool).

check: The PAF is located at the principal place of business in the U.S. OR at the place of employment, and a member of the public may examine it (transcription/scanning/photograph; copies need not be provided).
threshold: Location ∈ {principal place of business in U.S., place of employment}. Access: must permit transcription/scanning/photography on request; no mailing/handing-over of copies.
citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a) (location); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62F (access method); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
information_needed: pafStorageLocationType (principalPlaceOfBusiness|placeOfEmployment|other); pafAddress; publicExaminationProcessDocumented (bool); allowsTranscriptionScanPhoto (bool); worksiteAddresses (for multi-site).

check: (Dependent/willful-violator, non-exempt LCA) No U.S. worker in an essentially-equivalent job displaced within 90 days before to 90 days after petition filing — including a secondary-employer inquiry.
threshold: 90 days before AND 90 days after petition filing (direct) / placement (secondary). "Essentially equivalent" = comparable duties/qualifications in the same area (commuting distance / same MSA).
citation: 20 CFR 655.738(c) (direct, 90/90); 655.738(d) (secondary, inquiry + 90/90); 655.738(b) (definitions: lay off; essentially equivalent job; same-area/MSA test); 655.738(e) (documentation).
information_needed: Dependency/willful-violator + exempt-only flags; petition filing date; U.S.-worker separations same occupation/area within ±90 days (+ reason codes); secondary-placement flag + date + documented inquiry; essentially-equivalent-job mapping.

check: Response to a USCIS NOID filed within 30 days (the regulatory max), +3 days if served by mail.
threshold: Max 30 days from issuance (date on the notice controls). +3 days if served by mail.
citation: 8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)(iv) (30-day max for NOID); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
information_needed: caseId, noidIssuanceDate, noidResponseDueDate (as printed), serviceMethod, responseFiledDate.

check: PAF contains a full, clear explanation of the system used to set the "actual wage" (incl. periodic increases).
threshold: A written explanation/memo OR pay scale documenting how the actual wage is determined, including periodic increases.
information_needed: actualWageMemoPresent (bool); actualWageMemoDate; lcaFilingDate; describesPeriodicIncreases (bool); occupation/SOC.

check: (L-1B) Total stay in specialized-knowledge capacity ≤5 years.
threshold: 5 years cumulative L-1B. ≤2-year increments. Time physically outside the U.S. is recapturable; 1 full year abroad resets eligibility.
citation: INA 214(c)(2)(D)(ii) (8 USC 1184(c)(2)(D)); 8 CFR 214.2(l)(12)(i); (l)(15)(ii); USCIS PM Vol 2 Part L Ch 9.
information_needed: classification (L-1B); cumulative_us_l_days_or_years; admission_history; periods_physically_outside_us; days_in_other_status_H_or_L; current_validity_end; requested_extension_period; recapture_claim_days.

check: A bona fide employer-employee relationship with right-to-control exists between petitioner and beneficiary (critical for third-party/client-site placements).
threshold: Qualitative right-to-control (supervision, assignment, hire/fire/discipline, tools, work-setting indicia). A valid contract/SOW chain from petitioner through intermediaries to the end-client, plus petitioner-retained supervisory control, is the readiness bar.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(ii) (United States employer); 8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(i)(B)(1) (third-party worksite inspection authority); USCIS PM-602-0157 (Contracts and Itineraries).
information_needed: Per beneficiary/placement: placement type (direct vs third-party); end-client + worksite; contract/SOW chain (petitioner→vendor(s)→client) + validity dates; who supervises/assigns; petitioner's legal-presence proof, service-of-process agent, IRS tax ID; itinerary of services.

check: The LCA was filed while its supporting NPWC PWD was within the PWD validity window.
threshold: 90 ≤ PWD validity ≤ 365 days; filing date ∈ [determination date, expiration date].
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A); DOL OFLC NPWC guidance (validity period).
information_needed: PWD determination/issue date; PWD expiration date; LCA filing date.

check: Employer did NOT improperly reverify documents/persons on the no-reverify list.
threshold: No reverification demanded based on expiry of US passport/passport card/Form I-551, a List B doc, or for a US citizen/national/LPR.
information_needed: recorded Section-2 doc type; Section-1 status attested; reverification events + the doc type that triggered them.

check: Employer took NO adverse action against an employee contesting a TNC (case pending / referred / in continuance).
threshold: Zero adverse actions attributable to the mismatch until Final Nonconfirmation (or close with authorization).
citation: E-Verify MOU Art. II §A (paras 12-13, no-adverse-action / close-without-liability); E-Verify User Manual §3.3; 8 USC 1324b (anti-discrimination overlay: (a)(1) citizenship/national-origin + (a)(5) anti-retaliation).
information_needed: caseStatus timeline (TNC|referred|continuance|FNC|closed); adverse-action events (termination/suspension/hour-reduction/pay-change) with dates; reason codes.

check: Referred employee given the 8-federal-working-day window to contact SSA/DHS, reflected in the Referral Date Confirmation.
threshold: Employee has 8 federal government working days from referral; employer must provide the Referral Date Confirmation.
citation: **E-Verify User Manual §3.3.3 "Refer Employee To DHS or SSA"** (with §3.3.2 "Confirm Employee Decision" as cross-ref); E-Verify MOU Art. II. **The supplied §3.3.2 URL/slug is stale/dead** (manual renamed "tnc" → "mismatch").
information_needed: referralDate; referralDateConfirmationProvided (bool); federalWorkingDayCalendar.

check: Continued employment past I-94 expiry is covered by the 240-day rule only if a timely extension was filed with the same employer (else unauthorized employment).
threshold: ≤240 days from I-94 expiry, conditioned on a TIMELY-FILED (before expiry) extension with the SAME employer in an eligible class.
citation: 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(20) (240-day continued employment); filing basis 8 CFR 214.2 / 214.6.
information_needed: employeeId, classification, i94ExpiryDate, extensionPetitionFiledDate, extensionSameEmployerFlag, extensionEligibleCategoryFlag, extensionDecisionDate/Result, employmentContinuedFlag.

check: The employer's I-983 attestations are present and truthful: sufficient resources/personnel to train; will not replace a U.S. worker; the opportunity assists training goals.
threshold: All three attestations (i)-(iii) made and signed; each must be true.
information_needed: I-983 attestation checkboxes/signature; employer headcount + training personnel at the worksite; recent layoff/RIF/furlough records; training-resources description; worksite location(s).

check: Paid wage ≥ greater of (actual wage, prevailing wage) for the entire period of authorized employment.
threshold: paid_wage ≥ MAX(actual_wage, prevailing_wage). No de minimis — any underpayment is a violation.
information_needed: Per worker: actual gross wage paid; pay frequency; actual_wage benchmark; prevailing_wage; LCA validity start/end; FT/PT; hours.

check: On a TNC (mismatch), employer notified the employee promptly and completed required referral steps within 10 federal government working days.
threshold: Employer action (notify + confirm decision + refer if contested) within 10 federal government working days of TNC issuance.
citation: E-Verify MOU Art. II §A; E-Verify User Manual §3.3 (incl. 3.3.1 Notify / 3.3.2 Confirm Decision / 3.3.3 Refer); USCIS guidance "REMINDER: Employer Action Required on Tentative Nonconfirmations (Mismatches) within 10 Federal Government Working Days."
information_needed: tncIssueDate; employeeNotifiedDate; fanGivenDate; employeeDecisionDate; referralDate; federalWorkingDayCalendar.

check: An F-1 student who is the beneficiary of a timely-filed, cap-subject H-1B change-of-status petition gets automatic extension of F-1 D/S and OPT work authorization until April 1 of the relevant fiscal year (or H-1B start, whichever earlier).
threshold: Petition must be (a) cap-subject, (b) request COS (not consular), (c) filed while F-1 status or OPT is valid (timely). Cap-gap end = min(April 1 of the relevant FY, H-1B validity start). Ends immediately on rejection/denial/revocation/withdrawal.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(5)(vi); H-1B Modernization final rule, 89 FR 103054 (Dec 18, 2024) (cap-gap end → April 1).
information_needed: f1Opt.authorizationEndDate, h1bPetition.capSubject (bool), requestsCOS (bool), filedDate, status (pending/approved/denied/withdrawn), validityStart, capSelectionYear.

check: SOC code and wage level consistent across the H-1B registration, the certified LCA, and the I-129 (incl. Q7–Q11) — no level-shopping or post-hoc downgrade.
threshold: SOC identical (or defensibly mapped) across all three; the I-129-requirements-implied level (DOL 4-factor mapping) must equal the certified LCA level. n/a single numeric.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731 (required wage = greater of actual or prevailing); 8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A)/(E); DOL ETA PW Guidance (Nov-2009) level methodology.
information_needed: registration.socCode; registration.wageLevelProxy (if captured); lca.socCode; lca.wageLevel; lca.prevailingWage; lca.actualWage; hSupp.q7..q11; i129.socCode.

check: Retains a memo/documentation describing the actual-wage system and how the H-1B wage relates to others.
threshold: Existence + adequacy of the actual-wage memo.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(b); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c).
information_needed: Boolean: actual-wage memo present; date; whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll.

check: Moving the worker to a worksite outside the existing MSA/area of intended employment (requiring a new LCA) is a MATERIAL CHANGE requiring an amended petition (Matter of Simeio Solutions).
threshold: New worksite OUTSIDE the existing MSA/area of intended employment AND requiring a new LCA → amended petition, filed BEFORE the worker begins at the new location. Within-MSA: posting only.
citation: Matter of Simeio Solutions, LLC, 26 I&N Dec. 542 (AAO 2015); 8 CFR 214.2(h)(2)(i)(E); 8 CFR 214.2(h)(11)(i)(A); LCA worksite/posting 20 CFR 655.734; short-term placement 20 CFR 655.735.
information_needed: approvedPetition.worksites[] (with MSA), newWorksite.address + derived MSA, newLCA.certified (bool) + certifiedDate, moveEffectiveDate, amendedPetition.filedDate, shortTermPlacement (bool, days).

check: Section 2 completed within 3 business days of the first day of employment.
threshold: 3 business days; first day of employment = day 0, due by end of 3rd business day after. Weekends + federal holidays excluded.
citation: 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii); short-engagement exception 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(iii); penalty 8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2).
information_needed: hire/start date; section2CompletionDate (employer sign date); businessDayCalendar (federal holidays); employmentDurationDays.

check: Photo-matching step performed and, on a photo-mismatch contest, a copy of the employee's document submitted to DHS.
threshold: Photo comparison recorded; on photo-mismatch contest, document copy uploaded to DHS.
citation: E-Verify User Manual §2.2.2 (E-Verify Photo Matching) and §3.3 (TNC handling); E-Verify MOU Art. II.
information_needed: section2DocType; photoMatchResult (match|no-match|recorded); on photo-TNC contest: documentCopySubmittedToDHS (bool); copyRetained (bool).

check: Prevailing wage from an acceptable source, correct skill level, within its validity window at filing.
threshold: PWD validity ≥90 and ≤365 days. Survey recency: data collected within 24 months preceding publication; latest published edition (published within 24 months before filing). Academic/research employers: level reflects only such institutions.
citation: **20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)** (PW determined "as of the time of filing"; greater-of); **655.731(a)(2)(i)** (CBA); **655.731(a)(2)(ii) / (a)(2)(ii)(A)** (OFLC NPC/OES, arithmetic mean of BLS OES); **655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A)** (validity "not less than 90 days or more than 1 year") and **(a)(2)(ii)(A)(1)** (file LCA within the PWD validity period); **655.731(a)(2)(ii)(B)/(C)** (independent authoritative / other legitimate source); **655.731(a)(2)(vii)** (academic/nonprofit-research carve-out); **655.731(b)(3) / (b)(3)(iii)(B)-(C)** (documentation incl. 24-month recency). **For the wage LEVEL I–IV tiering, cite 20 CFR 656.40(b)(2) + DOL OFLC PW guidance, NOT 655.731** ("level I-IV" does not appear in 655.731).
information_needed: PW source type; PWD tracking number + issue + expiration (if OFLC); OES area + SOC + level; survey publication date + data-collection window; CBA citation; employer entity-type flag (academic/research).

check: Section 1 attestation signed AND dated by the employee.
threshold: Employee signature present AND date present.
citation: **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(i)(A)** (completes Section 1 "at the time of hire" and signs the attestation; preparer/translator assistance clause is in this same subparagraph) + **8 CFR 274a.2(a)(3)** (attestation "under penalty of perjury"). Deadline = "at the time of hire" per **8 CFR 274a.1(g)**, operationally end of first day per M-274. The DATE-field requirement derives from the **Form I-9 instructions / M-274**, not the reg. **DROP 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)** (that is the retention rule) and **DROP the Virtue Memo as authority for the signature mandate** (it governs the technical-vs-substantive classification only). Preparer/Translator = **Supplement A** (current Form I-9, 08/01/2023).
information_needed: section1SignaturePresent (bool); section1SignDate.

check: I-94 admit-until date governs authorized stay; flag the gap where I-94 expires before/after petition validity, and the 10-day pre/post admission grace.
threshold: Authorized stay = min(I-94 admit-until, petition validityEnd + 10 days). Work window = petition validityStart..validityEnd only. Unlawful presence begins the day AFTER I-94 expiry absent a timely-filed extension.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(h)(13)(i)(A) (validity + 10-day pre/post); 8 CFR 214.1(l)(1) (10-day grace); admit-until controlling per 8 CFR 214.1(a)(3); unlawful-presence bars INA 212(a)(9)(B) / 8 USC 1182(a)(9)(B).
information_needed: i94.admitUntilDate, i94.mostRecentEntryDate, petition.validityStart/End, visaStamp.expiry (informational), any pending extension receipt + filing date.

check: An eligible H-1B beneficiary may begin new/concurrent employment upon the FILING of a nonfrivolous H-1B petition by the new employer — before approval — under AC21 §105 / INA §214(n).
threshold: Work may begin on max(petitionFiledDate, requestedStartDate). Petition MUST be filed before I-94 admit-until expiry (an expired I-94 from a prior portability petition still counts as "period of stay authorized" for a successive port — bridge porting). Requires NO unauthorized employment since last admission.
information_needed: newPetition.filedDate, requestedStartDate, nonfrivolous (bool/attested), beneficiary.currentStatus, i94.admitUntilDate, beneficiary.unauthorizedEmploymentSinceAdmission (bool), priorPortabilityChain[].

check: Receipt for a lost/stolen/damaged document handled within the receipt rule and replaced within 90 days.
threshold: Replacement presented within 90 days of hire (or reverification trigger). Receipt rule unavailable for <3-day hires.
citation: **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(vi)(A)** (lost/stolen/damaged receipt + 90-day replacement); short-term <3-day exception **8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(iii)** (also restated in (b)(1)(vi)); **distinct arrival-document and refugee receipts at 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(vi)(B) and (b)(1)(vi)(C)** — NOT (b)(1)(iii); **M-274 §4.4**.
information_needed: receiptUsed (bool); receiptType; hireDate (or reverification date); replacementDocPresentedDate; employmentDurationDays.

check: Every worksite where the worker performs work is within the area of intended employment on a certified LCA (or covered by short-term-placement / Simeio amendment).
threshold: Within normal commuting distance / same MSA. Non-worksite carve-outs: peripatetic ≤5; based-elsewhere occasional ≤10 consecutive workdays.
citation: 20 CFR 655.715 (definitions); 655.731(a)(2) (PW tied to area of intended employment).
information_needed: Per worker: current worksite address(es) + MSA; LCA worksite address(es) + MSA; commuting/MSA mapping; consecutive-workday counts at off-LCA locations.

check: On the July-1 OES refresh, do not require a new PWD for an already-filed LCA, but recheck new filings against updated data.
threshold: Effective July 1; pre-existing certified LCAs grandfathered; new filings use new data.
citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii) (OES survey); OFLC OEWS wage-year update (effective July 1).
information_needed: LCA filing date vs the active wage-year boundary (July 1); cited wage-data vintage; PWD validity dates.

check: Map a found violation to the minimum debarment (program-disqualification) period.
information_needed: Violation tier (from cmp-tiers rule); willfulness; displacement finding.

check: Student on STEM OPT completes the recurring validation report every 6 months, confirming the (f)(12)(ii)(A) information has not changed, within 10 business days of each reporting date.
threshold: Every 6 months (reporting dates at +6, +12, +18, +24 months from start); each due within 10 business days of the reporting date.
information_needed: STEM OPT start, end, F-1 status expiration, validation-report submission dates, business-day calendar.

check: LCA used only within its certified validity period; H-1B petition not relying on an expired/withdrawn LCA.
threshold: Max validity 3 years (H-1B). Earliest filing: 6 months before start.
citation: 20 CFR 655.750(a) (validity, 3-yr max); 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months before start).
information_needed: Per LCA: certified start, certified end, filing date, intended start; mapped H-1B petition validity dates.

check: (Dependent/willful-violator, non-exempt LCA) Good-faith industry-standard recruitment of U.S. workers at ≥ required wage; job offered to any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant; documented in the PAF.
threshold: Recruitment comp ≥ required wage; offer mandatory to any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant. No fixed ad count; must meet industry norms.
citation: 20 CFR 655.739(e) (industry-wide standards: (e)(1) internal+external, (e)(2) some active); 655.739(f)-(g) (legitimate, non-skewing criteria); 655.739(i)(4) (PAF summary); 655.739(j) (must offer to qualified U.S. applicant, 8 USC 1182(n)(1)(G)(i)(II), DOJ-enforced).
information_needed: Dependency/exempt flags; recruitment method list with dates/places; compensation offered vs required wage; applicant log + disposition; record of any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant and whether offered; PAF recruitment summary present.

check: A qualifying corporate relationship (parent/branch/subsidiary/affiliate) exists between the U.S. petitioner and the foreign entity.
threshold: Subsidiary: >50%+control; or 50%+control; or 50% of a 50-50 JV with equal control/veto; or <50% with de facto control. Affiliate: common ownership/control by the same parent/individual/proportionate group. Exactly ONE qualifying relationship.
citation: 8 CFR 214.2(l)(1)(ii)(G) (qualifying organization); (I) Parent; (J) Branch; (K) Subsidiary; (L) Affiliate; INA 101(a)(15)(L) (8 USC 1101(a)(15)(L)).
information_needed: petitioner_entity_id; foreign_entity_id; relationship_type; ownership_percent; control_evidence_flag (stock ledger / operating agreement / board minutes / audited financials / tax returns); joint_venture_flag; veto_power_flag; common_parent_or_individual_owner_id.
